list.title: Profiles
list.emptyBody: Profiles save named presets of plugins, skills, and settings for Claude Code sessions. Click + above to create your first profile.

topBar.configureSubtitle: Configure plugins and skills for this profile
topBar.importResult:

overview.title: Profile Overview
overview.description: Summary of what this profile will load when launched. Click a category to see details.

emptyState.chooseProfile: Choose a profile from the sidebar, or create a new one to get started.

defaultBanner: This is your default profile. Running `claude` in any terminal launches with these plugins and settings. Add only what you need for everyday use.

health.missingPlugins: {{count}} missing plugin(s) — choose "Add plugin" to find it in the marketplace or "Remove" to drop it from this profile.

filter.skillsPlaceholder: Search skills by name or plugin…
filter.agentsPlaceholder: Filter agents by name or plugin…
filter.commandsPlaceholder: Search commands by name or plugin…

noItems: No {{tab}} available. Install plugins to see {{tab}} here.

local.selectDirHint: Choose a directory in the topbar to see project-specific skills, agents, and commands.
local.noItemsHint: Add skills, agents, or commands to your project's `.claude/` directory and they'll appear here.
local.itemsFromDir: Items from `{{dir}}`/.claude/ — these are loaded automatically when launching into this directory, independent of profile settings.
local.addMoreItemsHint: Drop skills, agents, or commands into this project's `.claude/` directory and they'll appear here alongside profile-level items.

instructions.claudeMdHint: Appended to CLAUDE.md — Claude reads this every turn.
instructions.workflowHint: Invoked on demand — runs when you type `/workflow` in a session.
instructions.workflowPlaceholder: Describe how this profile should orchestrate its tools — e.g. “First run the code-explorer agent, then invoke systematic-debugging, then produce a bulleted report.”

variants.title: Workflow Variants
variants.hint: Named variants become `/workflow-name` commands. Optionally scope to a specific project directory.

dialogs.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete `{{name}}`?
dialogs.deleteDefaultWarning: This is your default profile. Deleting it means running `claude` will load all installed plugins.
dialogs.deleteCannotUndo: This will remove the profile configuration and its assembled config directory. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.pluginNotFoundDesc: `{{name}}` isn't available in any curated marketplace we can see
dialogs.pluginNotFoundRemove: It may have been removed, renamed, or only lives in a private marketplace you haven't added. Remove it from this profile?

settings.opusContextHint: Opus 1M context is included in your plan.
settings.sonnetContextHint: Sonnet 1M context is billed as extra usage outside your plan.
settings.overrideGlobalStatusBar: Override global status bar for this profile
settings.statusBarOverrideHint: This profile uses its own widget config, seeded from the global status bar. Edits made in Configure Claude → Status Bar apply to the global config only; per-profile overrides persist independently and take effect for sessions launched via this profile.
settings.statusBarDefaultHint: When off, sessions launched via this profile use the global status bar from Configure Claude → Status Bar.
settings.authSharedHint: This profile shares credentials with your default Claude Code installation.
settings.authOwnHint: This profile will use its own credentials. You'll need to authenticate separately on first launch.
settings.envVarsHint: Environment variables set when this profile launches.
settings.hooksHint: Global hooks inherited from ~/.claude/settings.json. Toggle off to disable for this profile.
settings.claudeOverrideDisabledHint: `claude` will load with all {{count}} installed addon(s) — no profile filtering applied
settings.claudeOverrideEnabledHint: Profile controls which of the {{count}} addon(s) load into `claude` sessions
settings.addAliasesHint: Add aliases to launch this profile from the terminal.
settings.aliasPromptPlaceholder: Enter the prompt to send on launch...
settings.aliasesSavedHint: Aliases are saved to ~/.claudeworks/bin/. `Add to PATH` to use from any terminal.
settings.runAliasHint: Run any alias name from your terminal to launch this profile.
settings.removeAsDefaultHint: Clears default status. Running `claude` will fall back to vanilla Claude (no profile), and another profile can take the default slot.
settings.setAsDefaultHint: Makes this profile the default. Running `claude` will launch with this profile's plugins and settings.
settings.launchPromptHint: Fires automatically when launching this profile (no alias invoked). Supports slash commands like `/workflow` or a free-form prompt. Leave empty to launch without an initial prompt.
settings.customFlagsHint: Flags passed to `claude` when launching this profile
settings.configDirHint: View this profile's assembled settings, plugins, and CLAUDE.md

descriptions.default: Your default profile. Running `claude` launches with these plugins and settings.
